addOptionalField1.description:
This field has the same requirement as its base, so it shouldn't be reported
by the additions metric.

addOptionalField2.description:
This field has a stricter requirement than its base, so it should by flagged
by the additions metric.

addOptionalFieldWithDefault.description:
This field has a stricter requirement than its base, but it also has a default
value, so it shouldn't be flagged by the additions metric.

addRequiredFieldWithDefault.description:
This field has the same requirement as its base, so it shouldn't be reported
by the additions metric regardless of its default value.

addInheritedField.description:
This declaration is added but the field itself exists in both versions. The
field is unchanged by this declaration, so it shouldn't be flagged by metrics.
